caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a curved, lyre-shaped backrest that includes decorative scrolls and a central vertical bar with horizontal crosspieces, resembling a musical lyre. The chair is shown at an angle, with four legs, each slightly splayed. The front legs terminate in detailed carved animal feet, while the rear legs curve backwards. The seat is a light yellowish-cream color, appearing cushioned, and contrasts with the darker brown hues of the wooden frame. The style is simple, with the primary focus on the elegant, smoothly contoured lines and ornamental back design, all set against an unadorned pale background.
title: Side Chair
